about: The golden set for the product page reader (contract §2.11): real shop pages, studied on 2026-11-05. Their HTML is saved (git-ignored) in fixtures/pages/<id>/ with the feeds that answered then; nothing from them is committed. Expected values were read by hand from each page; dims are [w, d, h] in cm (checked within 1 cm or 1.5 %), in order, as a prefix of dims_candidates. 'variants' lists the shop's size options in order. 'image0' must be in the first picture's URL. Shops change: a live run that differs from a snapshot run is a shop change until shown otherwise.

pages.pattern: WooCommerce shop (the user's carpet shop); JSON-LD Product without sizes; sizes only as unitless variant terms 3*4 … 4*8; the page's custom-size form measures in metres (Length (m))
IKEA, metric: JSON-LD Product with width/depth/height as "80 cm" text; also a 3DModel block
IKEA, US: JSON-LD width/depth/height in inches with fractions (31 1/2 ", 41 3/4 ")

Shopify (8 MB page, microdata, no JSON-LD Product): sizes in text, inches with letters 101" L X 40" D X 30.5" H; box sizes and seat/arm heights as distractors; the .json feed body says 101"W x 30.5"H x 40"D
Shopify rug: JSON-LD ProductGroup variesBy size, hasVariant size "7' 6\" x 9' 6\"" (feet and inches); the .js feed has a Size option

Shopify rug: JSON-LD Product whose offers are named "… - 3'11\" x 5'7\" Rectangle"; a size guide table with nominal sizes (4x6) next to actual ones and shipping sizes (LxWxH) as distractors; Thickness: 0.45" and Pile Height: 0.29"

Shopify: JSON-LD ProductGroup with colour variants; the size only in a collapsed accordion 387 KB into the page, with curly inch marks and both W and L: Overall 16” W x 13” L x 7” H (it clamps to the bed frame, so 7" is right); the feeds answered 429 when studied
WooCommerce (Yoast JSON-LD Product without sizes); the Store API has dimensions 0 × 0 × 0 and no size attribute; no size in the served HTML

Large retailer rendered in the browser: og:title and og:image only; the size is in an inline script's JSON: "Dimensions (Overall): 71.18 Inches (H) x 24.49 Inches (W) x 11.57 Inches (D)", with recommended products' sizes after it
Blocks downloads: 403 Access Denied to any non-browser client

expect.error: This shop blocks automatic reading: paste the image link and size instead.
